poster-maker.formula:
Canvas: 1080 x 1350 px (4:5 portrait).
Headline: bold system font, up to 132 px, wrapped to fit an 860 px column.
Safe margins: 140 px on all sides; footer pinned 140 px from the bottom.
Export: PNG via canvas.toDataURL, one file per click.
howTo: Pick a template: Sunset for sales and events, Minimal for professional notices, Festive for celebrations.
Type your headline, subtitle, details (date, venue — one per line), and footer line.
Watch the live preview update with every keystroke.
When it looks right, press Download PNG and save the file.
Share the PNG on WhatsApp or social media, or print it — the resolution suits A4 and smaller prints.
keyFacts: Every poster renders on a 1080 x 1350 px canvas — a 4:5 portrait ratio that looks sharp on Instagram, WhatsApp status, and A4 prints.
Three built-in templates: Sunset (bold gradient), Minimal (clean white), and Festive (dark celebration). Each re-lays-out your text automatically.
Long headlines wrap automatically so text never overflows the safe margins.
Download is a standard PNG file, typically 300 to 600 KB, ready to share or print.
Everything runs in your browser with plain canvas drawing — no account, no upload, no watermark added to your design.

poster-maker.workedExample: A shop owner needs a weekend sale poster. She picks the Sunset template and types the headline 'Mega Sale' (8 characters, fits on one line at 128 px), the subtitle 'Up to 50% off everything', details 'Saturday, 24 October, 10 AM onwards' on line one and 'City Mall, Main Road' on line two, and the footer 'Visit our store today'. The tool centers the headline at 560 px from the top, stacks the subtitle 150 px below it, pins the details 320 px from the bottom, and exports a 1080 x 1350 PNG of roughly 450 KB — ready for her WhatsApp status in under a minute.
